messages.en:
When life beans you with a
curveball, you should go to
the beach, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{06 01 00 08 09 0a}
messages.et:
Kui elu viskab sulle
kõvera palli, peaksid sa
randa minema, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{06 01 00 08 09 0a}

Hei {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} kas sa ei
arva, et meri on tõesti
hiiglaslik, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{06 00 00 12 13}

messages.en:
Get a whiff of that, kid!{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}
Salty sea air is so
invigorating, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Maybe I shouldn't drink so
much seawater, though. {01 00 00 05 00}It's
not so refreshing...
messages.et:
Nuusuta seda, laps!{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}
Soolane mereõhk on nii
turgutav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Ehk ei peaks ma küll nii
palju merevett jooma. {01 00 00 05 00}See
pole nii värskendav...

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Ever wanna go to the beach
so badly that you think
your head's gonna 'splode?{02 00 00 0e 0f}
Totally!
Not so much.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Kas sa oled kunagi tahtnud
nii väga randa, et tundub,
et pea plahvatab?{02 00 00 0e 0f}
Täiesti!
Mitte eriti.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}I like to {04 22 00},
but I was in the mood to go
to the beach today.
Relaxing on the beach will
cure anyone's nasty mood.

{07 15 00}Don't forget that! It's one 
of {04 01 00}'s rules to 
live by, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}Mulle meeldib {04 22 00},
aga täna oli mul tuju
randa minna.
Rannas lõõgastumine ravib
kõigi halva tuju ära.

{07 15 00}Ära unusta seda! Selle 
järgi elab {04 01 00}, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Some of my best schemes 
have been hatched while
spacing out at the beach.
{06 00 00 10 11}
messages.et:
Mõned mu parimad plaanid 
on haudunud välja siis, kui
olen rannas unelenud.
{06 00 00 10 11}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}We're nothin' compared to
the wonder of the big blue
sea, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}Think on that for a while
next time you think you're
all that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Me pole midagi võrreldes
suure sinise mere imega,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}Mõtle sellele natuke,
kui sa järgmine kord arvad,
et oled kõva, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Think of the beach as the
set of a big-budget movie.

{07 00 00}You're the star, and
there's a huge spotlight
shining on you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mõtle rannast kui suure
eelarvega filmivõttest.

{07 00 00}Sina oled täht ja sinu
peale paistab hiiglaslik
prožektor, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Me?{01 00 00 0f 00} Naw, I'm not
sleepy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 19 00}I'm just kickin' back and
chilling out on the beach, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Mina?{01 00 00 0f 00} Ei, ma pole
unine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 19 00}Ma lihtsalt puhkan ja
lõõgastun rannas, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Man, I hate it when people 
yap on and on using words 
like "calm" and "soothing."
{07 00 00}That's all a bunch of 
hogwash if ya ask me, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Poiss, ma vihkan, kui 
inimesed lobisevad sõnu 
nagu „rahulik” ja „leebe”.
{07 00 00}See on minu arust 
kõik jama, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}That means you're just a
big baby{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 19 00}Either that, or a grown-up
who has a boring life!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Which is it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}See tähendab, et sa oled
suur beebi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 19 00}Või siis täiskasvanu,
kellel on igav elu!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Kumb see on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}That's why that 
philosophizing otter is 
always staring out to sea.
He's doing some deep diving
in his brain, thinking...
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Sellepärast see 
filosofeeriv saarmas 
vahibki alati merd.
Ta sukeldub sügavale
oma ajju ja mõtleb...
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Man, I have to admire{01 00 00 05 00}
somebody that just doesn't
give a rip, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
You know, somebody who
just lives their life the
way they want to!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Poiss, ma pean imetlema{01 00 00 05 00}
kedagi, kes lihtsalt ei
hooli millestki, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Tead küll, kedagi, kes
lihtsalt elab oma elu nii,
nagu ta tahab!

{07 00 00}Maitsev ahvenafilee, mida
ma söön pärast seda, kui
{04 22 00} terve päeva{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0e 00}Ja õhtusöögijärgne tass
{04 13 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00} {07 0a 00}Pole
midagi paremat!
